shell_commands:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test: add acceptance tests for usage accumulation across tool rounds

Define acceptance tests for ticket #93: report usage across every tool
round, not just the last. The hook afterModelResponse should receive
usage totaling all provider calls in a turn, not only the final round.

Tests verify:
- Multi-round usage is summed correctly with different token counts
- Single-round behavior remains unchanged (backward compatibility)
- Missing usage from some rounds doesn't produce undefined or NaN
- Three-round accumulation works across multiple rounds
- Undefined is correctly passed when no round reports usage

All tests currently fail as expected since accumulation is not yet
implemented in chatOrchestrator.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
